verdict.rationale: Working Copy is a Git client, and Git clients can plausibly ship embedded terminals, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents SSH only as a Git transport (protocols, SSH keys, SSH commands for listing repositories on self-hosted servers). Nothing shows interactive terminal sessions, let alone multiple sessions with separate context, appearance and history.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history
